$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Screenshots pane settings; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: screenshots
lists.note: The Screenshots pane (cmux://screenshots, action screenshots.open): the folders it lists besides the macOS screenshot folder and its preview folder. Parsed by ScreenshotsSettings.

rows.note: On by default. On: the pane also lists the save and history folders of the screenshot tools it finds (CleanShot X, Shottr, Xnapper, Snagit, Monosnap, Skitch, Flameshot, Kap, Cap, QuickTime).

help.text: The Screenshots pane also shows the folders of screenshot apps it finds, such as CleanShot X, Shottr and Kap.

rows.note: More folders the pane lists: absolute or ~/ paths. A folder that does not exist is not listed.

help.text: The Screenshots pane also shows the pictures and videos in these folders. Use full paths or ~/ paths.
